fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Miami hosting major conventions (including the Elks), civic hospitality and tourism, and local municipal matters. Coverage addresses Coral Gables Corporation financial troubles and their perceived impact on Florida real estate confidence; Miami harbor/dock rental negotiations; concerns about excessive numbers of dry-cleaning establishments; and criticism of local transportation and streetcar service and traffic enforcement. Also includes prohibition-era notes on liquor availability and prices, satirical local bulletins, letters to the editor on a proposed vice district and on city funding for the Miami baseball club, and entertainment listings and advertisements.
